## About
Art's Roofing is a family owned, locally operated roofing company based right here in League City. We are licensed and insured, and we know the roofing requirements for each of the local cities we work in.
We work on homes across the area, including Friendswood, Pearland, Webster, Dickinson, Seabrook, Kemah, Clear Lake Shores, Texas City and Galveston. Whether you need a new roof or a repair on the one you have, we don't stop until you're satisfied with the work.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 164 Google reviews. Give us a call and we will be glad to help.

## Services
- Roof inspections: We get up on the roof and into the attic to look for problems, then walk you through what we found and your options.
- Flat roof installations and repairs: New flat roofs and repairs on the flat roof you already have.
- Emergency roof repair: True 24/7 emergency service when your roof can't wait.
- Residential roofing: New roofs and roof work for homes in and around League City.
- Roof coatings: Elastomeric roof coatings to help protect the roof you have.
- Exterior painting: Exterior painting as part of our general contracting work.
- HardiPlank siding: HardiPlank siding installed by our crew.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency roof repair?
A: Yes. We offer true 24/7 emergency service.

Q: Can you give me references from past customers?
A: Yes. We can provide a list of former customers as references.
